Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ayaan - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Hema - 39 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Sanjay - 38 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
3. The fishermen's village - boats, nets, coconut palms
4. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ayaan stands in the living room. Hema and Sanjay stand near him.]

Ayaan: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Ayaan reads a storybook.]

Hema: "Okay, Ayaan."

[Ayaan writes in his notebook.]

Sanjay: "That's easy."

[Ayaan studies for his exam.]

Ayaan: "I'm ready!"

[Ayaan talks to his father on the phone.]

Ayaan (softly): "Careful!"

[Ayaan's phone rings and he answers it.]

Ayaan (softly): "And then?"

Scene 2: The snowy hillside - Day

[Ayaan stands in the snow. Hema and Sanjay stand near him.]

Sanjay: "What a nice place."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Sanjay: "Well done!"

[Ayaan makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Ayaan: "Let's see."

[Ayaan builds a snowman.]

Ayaan (happily): "Dad, are you okay?"

[Ayaan catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Ayaan: "How beautiful!"

[Ayaan slides down the snowy slope.]

Hema (laughing): "I'm ready!"

Scene 3: The fishermen's village - Day

[Ayaan stands in the village. Hema and Sanjay stand near him.]

Ayaan: "So, here we are!"

[Waves crash against the shore.]

Sanjay: "That was fun!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Hema and Sanjay stand near him.]

Hema: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan stamps his foot in anger.]

Sanjay: "I knew it!"

[Snow begins to fall.]

Ayaan: "What next?"

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Ayaan: "Mom, look at this."

[The sun is blazing and Ayaan is sweating.]

Hema: "Exactly right."

[Ayaan feeds the dog.]

Sanjay: "That was such a fun day!"
